gl:definition.gl:content: identifier recorded at the finest available granularity for an object class for which no passport regime yet exists, held as issuance evidence for adoption by a future regime

gl:notes.gl:content: When a future regime issues passports for the object class it adopts the recorded dormant identifiers rather than minting new ones, so that the installed base connects retroactively through its build records.
Inputs are recorded even when no passport exists behind them yet; minting fresh identifiers would orphan the installed base.

gl:ref.gl:id: The passport relationship algebra; deepening granularity
